##### Project general facts

Lawncrest by Zimaya Properties is a contemporary residential development located in Dubai Production City, designed as a modern living space set against a lush green backdrop. The project features a ground floor, 2 podium plus 8 residential floors configuration, offering a total of 183 units, including studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments with select layouts featuring storage and maid’s rooms. Overlooking one of Dubai’s finest golf landscapes, it creates a serene and elevated lifestyle environment.

The development is built around a lifestyle-focused concept, offering a wide range of amenities for comfort and leisure. Residents can enjoy a swimming pool, fully equipped gym, yoga lounge, clubhouse, kids’ pool, and social games area, along with outdoor features such as BBQ lounges, cabanas, walking tracks, outdoor cinema, and landscaped seating areas. Additional highlights include smart home features and EV charging stations, creating a modern and community-oriented living experience.

The interiors are designed with attention to detail, combining practical layouts with quality finishes and branded fittings. Kitchens come equipped with appliances, while bathrooms feature premium sanitary ware, ensuring both functionality and style. The overall design emphasizes comfort, durability, and contemporary aesthetics. Residences are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Production City, formerly known as International Media Production Zone (IMPZ), is a vibrant and specialized community located in Dubai. It is designed to cater to the needs of the media production industry, offering a range of services, facilities, and infrastructure to support the production of print, publishing, and media content.

Dubai Production City is strategically positioned to serve as a hub for media production and related activities. The community features state-of-the-art production studios, soundstages, and post-production facilities, providing a comprehensive ecosystem for the media industry. It is home to numerous media companies, publishing houses, and creative professionals who contribute to the development of diverse content.

The community of Dubai Production City is designed to foster creativity, collaboration, and innovation. It offers a range of amenities and services to support the needs of media professionals, including commercial spaces, offices, and retail outlets. The community also hosts events, workshops, and networking opportunities that encourage knowledge sharing, skill development, and industry growth.
